product_risk_or_requirement: AI resume screening for employment may qualify as high-risk AI under Vietnam Law 134/2025/QH15 and Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg requiring registration and specific compliance obligations before deployment
current_state: Use case has a preliminary internal classification only; no legal counsel sign-off exists
product_requirement: Block production pilot launch until legal counsel maps the exact product workflow and target user base to the full Vietnam AI law and high-risk AI list and issues a signed classification memo
acceptance_criteria: Given the final product scope and target market When pilot launch readiness is reviewed Then a signed legal classification memo and system inventory record are present and on file with the Compliance team
deadline_or_trigger: Before any production pilot launch in Vietnam
evidence_needed: Signed legal classification memo; completed system inventory record mapped to Vietnam AI Law and Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg list

product_risk_or_requirement: Candidates have no awareness that AI scoring influences their shortlist position; no transparency or appeal mechanism exists for AI-influenced rejections
current_state: No candidate disclosure or appeal process is currently designed
product_requirement: Design and implement a candidate transparency notice and a human-reviewable appeal mechanism before pilot launch
acceptance_criteria: Given a candidate receives a human rejection decision When they request an explanation and appeal Then a named human reviewer responds within 5 business days with a documented rationale
evidence_needed: Completed transparency notice approved by legal; appeal procedure documented and tested with a pilot recruiter

product_risk_or_requirement: No pre-launch disparate-impact bias evaluation has been conducted on the scoring model against a representative candidate dataset
current_state: Scoring model has been unit-tested for accuracy but no demographic subgroup evaluation has been performed
product_requirement: Complete a pre-launch bias evaluation testing shortlist recall rates across gender proxy and age-bracket groups on a representative dataset before pilot launch
acceptance_criteria: Given a representative evaluation dataset covering all monitored groups When the bias evaluation report is reviewed by the independent reviewer Then recall gap across any two monitored groups is below 5 percentage points and the report is signed
evidence_needed: Independent bias evaluation report with subgroup recall metrics signed by Responsible AI Review Board

product_risk_or_requirement: Employment AI under EU AI Act Annex III is high-risk and requires conformity assessment human oversight controls and registration before placing on EU market
current_state: Product is not yet assessed for EU AI Act high-risk obligations; no role analysis or conformity assessment is planned
product_requirement: Complete EU AI Act role analysis human oversight design risk management documentation and conformity assessment before any EU market offer
acceptance_criteria: Given an EU launch candidate When release approval is requested Then applicability memo oversight procedure conformity assessment and approval evidence are all signed by authorised parties
deadline_or_trigger: Before offering the product in the EU
evidence_needed: Applicability memo; risk management evaluation; oversight procedure; conformity assessment evidence; EU market launch approval
